notes.title: Hot Dates DLC released!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, 


We just opened the page for the first DLC for [b]Tap 4 Sex[/b], called "[b]Hot Dates[/b]". 
This DLC brings you 2 new dates with Mia and Sophy, 10 new anims, and 15 new images. 


You can add the DLC to your wishlist now, and it will be released on 10th of July. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783140/Tap_4_Sex__Hot_Dates/"][/dynamiclink]

Please add it to your wishlist; every addition counts.

Depending on the interest we receive from you, we will consider creating more of these DLCs or not. 

Regards, Alex. [/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix 4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
We added another bug fix update ( hopefully the last one ), this time addressing a achievements problem. 
Now, each time you start a date, we do a check on all the achievements, and if for some reason, you had an achievement completed, but it was not awarded on Steam, we send the Achievement Notification again to Steam. Hopefully, this should clear the past problems we had with people not getting their achievements. 
We also changed the code, so now, when you buy Golden Hearts using the Exchange All button, they count towards your achievements. 
We also added an Achievements screen to the game, which shows all the achievements, their percentage of completion, and what you need to do to obtain them. 

All that being said, we wish you a great weekend and great fun.

notes.title: Bug Fix 3
notes.notes:
I pushed a bug fix for the bug we introduced in the previous update, the one that was causing the buying of Golden Hearts not to work anymore. 

All fixed now. 

P.S. I can't believe the game has been broken for the past 4 days, and we got a report just 2 hours ago...
